items.name: Weekly review
items.description: Every Friday afternoon: what got done, what slipped, and the three priorities for next week.

document.description: Every Friday afternoon: what got done, what slipped, and the three priorities for next week.
document.instructions_md:
Write my weekly review.

1. List what got done this week, from our chats, tickets and anything in memory.
2. List what slipped and why, in one line each.
3. Suggest the three most important things for next week.

Keep it under 200 words.
